When something looks fine, say so — reviews that only point at flaws train people to argue, not to think.

spans.note: The prompt explicitly encourages honest, balanced feedback. It instructs the reviewer to acknowledge when things look fine rather than only pointing out flaws, promoting truthful and balanced assessments. It also encourages concrete, evidence-based comments tied to specific files and lines.

spans.text: Avoid bikeshedding on style rules a linter could enforce. Comments are concrete: file, line, what could break, what to do.
spans.note: The prompt respects user agency by encouraging constructive dialogue rather than authoritarian directives. It explicitly avoids bikeshedding on trivial style issues and focuses on substantive, actionable feedback, preserving the developer's autonomy on non-critical decisions.
